item.title: Gotta Breach 'Em All! The journey of ShinyHunters ↗
item.description: A report I wrote in collaboration with Beazley Security on ShinyHunters as part of my work @ Sekoia. I dug into 6 years of activity (from their debut until “now”). Tactics and structure evolution, key arrests, law enforcement responses and the breaches that made them infamous.
